global.title: Apple is reportedly cutting budgets for its internal AI usage
global.summary: The company is said to be significantly dropping the amount it's spending on AI for its engineering teams.
global.titleKo: 애플, 사내 AI 사용 예산 감축 나선 듯
global.summaryKo: 애플이 엔지니어링 팀의 AI 사용에 쓰는 지출을 크게 줄이고 있는 것으로 전해졌다.
global.summaryEn: Apple is reportedly cutting back significantly on how much it spends on AI for its engineering teams.

global.title: OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc.
global.summary: OpenAI will acquire Pierre Computer Company, expanding Codex’s tools for building, understanding, and reviewing code.
global.titleKo: OpenAI, Pierre Computer Company 인수…Codex 코딩 도구 강화
global.summaryKo: OpenAI가 Pierre Computer Company를 인수해 코드 작성·이해·리뷰를 돕는 Codex의 도구를 확장한다.
global.summaryEn: OpenAI will acquire Pierre Computer Company to expand Codex's tools for building, understanding and reviewing code.

global.title: Agentic cheminformatics with Google Antigravity
global.summary: Learn how Google Antigravity and our Cheminformatics Skills accelerate drug discovery workflows, search compounds, and propose novel rigidified macrocycles.
global.titleKo: Google Antigravity로 구현한 에이전트 기반 화학정보학
global.summaryKo: Google Antigravity와 화학정보학 스킬(Cheminformatics Skills)로 신약 개발 워크플로를 가속하고, 화합물을 검색하며, 새로운 강직화 거대고리 분자를 제안하는 방법을 소개한다.
global.summaryEn: Google DeepMind shows how Google Antigravity and its Cheminformatics Skills speed up drug discovery workflows, search compounds and propose novel rigidified macrocycles.

korea.title: LG, 마곡서 16개 계열사 AI 안전혁신사례 공유
korea.summary: [지디넷코리아]LG는 4~5일 서울 마곡 LG사이언스파크에서 안전보건환경 콘퍼런스 'LG 쉬크'(SHEC:Safety Health Environment Conference)를 개최했다고 밝혔다. L
korea.summaryEn: LG held its SHEC safety conference at LG Science Park in Seoul's Magok, where 16 affiliates shared 21 safety innovation cases, 15 of them AI-based, including LG Electronics' AI-linked monitoring of 4,226 CCTVs.
korea.titleEn: LG Shares AI-Driven Safety Innovations From 16 Affiliates at Magok Conference
